segment.source: Renders two aligned columns — the old way on one side, your way on the other — with one row per point, so the contrast reads line by line instead of paragraph by paragraph. Use it for: replacing-a-spreadsheet arguments, migration pages, category-creation copy, sales pages aimed at a reader who already has a solution. Prefer 'Included Checklist' when there is nothing to compare against, and 'Spec Sheet' when both columns would be numbers rather than sentences.
